basis: Owner-provided November 2 Tokens and Requests hover screenshots, superseding the earlier coarse chart upper bound
component_bound_method: 118.7K uncached input + 13.3K output = approximately 132K; use 133000 to allow rounding. Do not subtract guessed cached tokens from future calls.
cached_tokens_exempt_documentation: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits and https://console.groq.com/docs/prompt-caching; checked with Context7 during this continuation
subsequent_usage_rule: Add all subsequent reported total tokens, including any cached tokens, or original reserved units if usage is missing, plus the unchanged 39840 worst-case next turn. Stop above 200000, on limits, unknown in-flight state, or unavailable accounting.
